pages.title: Create and Altitude Heat
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Working Create machines warm nearby players
- The hotter a Blaze Burner burns, the more it adds
- You need to be fairly close
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() High up the sky is colder; shelter cuts the chill

Create: Cold Sweat makes Create machines change the temperature of nearby players, so a working factory also heats the room.\
\
The heat idea itself is in [#](2E5AAC)[Heat](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]().

pages.title: Blaze Burner
pages.text: Warms nearby players. The hotter the flame, the more it adds: smouldering, fading, kindled, seething.

pages.title: Other sources
pages.text:
Also counted: **Steam Engines**, **Encased Fans**, **Fluid Tanks**, **Basins**, pipes and pumps.\
\
A working [#](7A3C9A)[steam boiler](entry://glossary/boiler)[#]() radiates more as its level rises. Lava in a container gives heat; water is neutral.

pages.title: Encased Fan
pages.text: A fan can take its temperature from the block it faces, so a fan blowing out of a fire or lava can heat a room.

pages.title: Range
pages.text: Each effect has a maximum range, so you need to be fairly close. Pipes and tanks only matter when they hold something hot or cold.

pages.title: Altitude
pages.text: Cold Sweat: Altitude splits the sky into temperature bands by [#](7A3C9A)[Y](entry://glossary/y_level)[#](), set in its own [#](7A3C9A)[config file](entry://glossary/config)[#](). Each band shows a message: "The mountain air grows colder." from Y 128, "The air grows colder at this altitude." from Y 192, "The air grows thin and bitter." from Y 256. Below ground Cold Sweat's steady cave temperatures apply instead.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** open sky is harsh. On an open deck above Y 192 you freeze in under a minute without insulation; leather buys about two minutes.\
\
A closed cabin with a roof and walls stops the chill completely, on the ground or on a ship.

pages.title: Airships
pages.text: Altitude also knows Create Aeronautics ships. Burners and steam vents aboard add heat, and an enclosed ship can shelter you from the chill. See [#](2E5AAC)[Airships](entry://flight/airships)[#]().

pages.title: Protection
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Most of the chill up high is wind. A **Windproof Lining** (four leather around a phantom membrane) sews onto armor at a Sewing Table; with one on every piece most of the wind chill is gone. The band's own cold stays.\
\
A roof and walls, or an enclosed Aeronautics ship, cut it too.
